text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring). Amid high 
expectations for Mejiro Palmer, Ikuno 
Dictus, Mejiro McQueen, and Rice Shower—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Word of Matikanetannhauser's performance 
in the Diamond Stakes had spread, building 
up immense expectations for her as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As various Umamusume traded sparks in 
pursuit of victory, the Tenno Sho (Spring) 
got underway...!
